heading: EXT. DUSTY CROSSROADS - FOOD TRUCK - DAY

units.text: EXT. DUSTY CROSSROADS - FOOD TRUCK - DAY
A weathered truck painted "BEANS & BRISKET - SINCE YESTERDAY" squats in the sun.
Heat shimmers.
A line of two teenagers in cowboy hats waits at the window while a mangy dog sleeps under the awning.
INSIDE, SADIE KROLL, 40s, cook, jaw like a knuckle, slaps patties on the flat-top.
Her brother-in-law CLETUS, 50s, leans on the counter pretending to count money.
At the window, a stranger in a long duster, MARSHAL REEVES, 60s, sets down his hat.
And in the corner, her teenage niece JOLENE, 17, wipes a spoon and watches everything.
CLOSE ON Reeves's badge, half hidden under the duster.
Two plates. And a word with Cletus.
units.name: REEVES

units.text: Marshal! Long way from town.
units.name: CLETUS

units.text: He's not here for beans, Cletus.
units.name: SADIE

units.text: The dog LIFTS its head.
A screen door SLAMS in the distance.
Where's the payroll box, Cletus?
units.name: REEVES

units.text: ANGLE ON Jolene's hand sliding a cleaver off the shelf.
Uncle Cletus, he's got a warrant folded in his boot.
units.name: JOLENE

units.text: Jolene, put that down.
units.name: CLETUS

units.text: Nobody's cutting anybody. Marshal, sit. Eat. Then we'll talk.
units.name: SADIE
paren: spinning around with a spatula held like a pistol

units.text: Sadie, you've never once made it easy.
units.name: REEVES
paren: tipping his hat back, almost smiling

units.text: BACK TO SCENE: the two teenagers bolt, the dog barks, a plate of brisket hits the dirt, and somewhere in the truck a timer DINGS.
